hypotheses.O0_tensor_edge_factorials_recompose: Role-group and QK/value Shapley decompositions recompose to relative error at most 1e-5, and role vectors sum to the selected program write with maximum absolute error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.O1_operand_profiles_transfer: Discovery-to-held-out role-profile cosine is at least 0.80 for at least five families.
hypotheses.O2_programs_use_relationally_relevant_so: Edited positions, answer mentions, and repeated-query positions jointly receive at least 0.50 held-out projection share for at least four material families.
hypotheses.O3_retrieval_uses_repetition_structure: Repeated-sequence retrieval assigns at least 0.40 held-out projection share to edited payload positions plus repeated query positions.
hypotheses.O4_binding_is_not_one_operand_type: IOI and agreement-with-attractor have role-profile cosine below 0.90 or different dominant source roles.
hypotheses.O5_value_change_is_common_but_not_assume: Changed values receive at least 0.60 QK/value Shapley projection share for at least four material families; failures are retained.
